notes.title: v1.1.0 - music, faster pacing, bug fixes, higher brightness, shields, fights
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added music to day 4-5
[*] All maps are now smaller to ensure a more engaging game pacing with less dull moments
[*] Shields are now inversed because it's more intuitive
[*] Small bug fixes
[*] Encounters are now more interesting - enemies are stacked together on day 2, enemies move a lot more on day 4
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.9 - smaller map sizes for days 1-3, increased brightness by a bit
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Decreased sizes of day 1,2,3 because there weren't enough different content to justify them being that long
[*] Increased brightness by a tiny bit
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.8 - streamer capture fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added window/fullscreen/windowed fullscreen options
[*] Added resolution options
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.5 hotfix
notes.content: Fix ship size to be a bit smaller to match the UI

notes.title: v1.0.5
notes.content:
Shield charger - doesn't depend on fps now, reset to default position on ship death/day change, reset to default position on charge depleted, easier control, more area covered by the shield

Hand movement - forward and backwards hand movement are now tied to sensitivity settings selected by user

Day 5 - improved events a bit

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content: Small bug fixes - potentially fixed an issue with events triggering on the start of the day instead of when they're supposed to be triggered

notes.title: V1.0.2
notes.content: Removed potential vsync, frame limit, capture frame times issues within unity that might have been limiting the frame rate.
